nom: Estée Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Lift + Sculpt Eye Cream

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including some sensitive specifically around the eyes or to fragrance, consistently report no stinging, redness, or irritation.
segments.oily: One reviewer who describes having oily skin most of her life says she has few facial lines even at 83, and now uses the eye cream preventively on early lines beside her nose and cheekbones.
segments.dry: One reviewer whose under-eye area tends to be dry says the cream keeps it looking plump and hydrated, preventing the cakey look she otherwise gets from concealer.
segments.mature: Reviewers ranging from their mid-40s to 83 years old report firmer, smoother under-eye skin, softened crow's feet, and reduced sagging with regular use, several noting visible results within two to four weeks.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers, especially with consistent use over two or more weeks, report visibly softer fine lines, lifted or firmer eyelids, and reduced crow's feet, some citing dramatic change after a month or more; a notable number, including some who tried it for under a month, say they saw no meaningful change in their lines, and one reviewer's dark circles worsened enough that she stopped using it and returned to a discontinued product.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe the eye area as visibly more hydrated and plump after use, several linking this to reduced puffiness and a less tired look; a couple found it left a greasy residue or wished it hydrated more.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive skin, report no stinging or redness; one reviewer loved the early results but developed reactions indicative of an allergy over continued use and had to stop.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report diminished dark circles with regular use, some citing dramatic improvement; one reviewer instead noticed a dark ring appearing around her eyes after starting the product and switched back to a previous formula.

aspects.libelle: Lightweight, silky texture that absorbs quickly
Pump or seal issues reported by some
Considered very expensive for the amount received
Subtle scent or none at all

extraits.titre: Good product but NO security seal
extraits.texte: Nice eye serum and absorbs quickly. I have sensitive skin (especially around the eyes area) and very happy that I did not experience any adverse reaction from this product. I deducted 2 stars because there is no security seal at all for the product - no clear wrapping for the exterior of the box nor any stickers to seal the top/bottom openings. Likewise, there is nothing to secure the interior bottle to ensure nothing has been tampered with. There are so many counterfeit products these days, Estee Lauder should take extra measures to ensure their products are tampered proof. I ordered couple of Aerin hand creams and similarly, they don't have any exterior or interior security seals. Drug store skincare products have better security protection than Estee Lauder...this is totally unacceptable!

Please bring the concentrate Matrix back. I use this product and I noticed dark ring around my eyes. I stopped using this product. I have always used the concentrate matrix which cleared up the dark ring, puffiness and wrinkles around my eyes

I received this product for free from Estée Lauder for testing and review purposes. I was kindly sent a 5 ml sample, and after using it each evening, I haven't noticed any significant improvements yet. I understand that skincare products often require consistent use over several weeks to show results, so this may take more time. The texture is smooth with a lightweight cream-gel formula. However, it does leave a greasy residue on my skin and takes longer to absorb compared to my usual eye cream, which is why I prefer using it only in the evenings. I also didn't find it to be as brightening as other eye products I've tried, so I unfortunately wouldn't purchase the full-size version.

Love the Advanced Night Repair Eye Lift +Sculpt! The dispenser is very stylish and ergonomically comfortable. It pumps consistently and smoothly. The repair cream is very creamy, moist and smooth. It goes on very easily and evenly. I've been using it for several months and find the little lines just above the cheek bone are no longer there and the crow's feet have lightened up as well. There's always a tad left on my; fingertips, which I use above and below my lips. I'm 83 and thanks to oily skin most of my life, I don't have many line on my face, but I'm now getting them below the eye alongside the nose, so I not only use the eye cream on my eyes, but I also press it in to the lines forming below the cheek bone and I find it has had a very positive effect, definitely preventing them from worsening. Thanks, Estee Lauder!

I've been using the Estée Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Lift + Sculpt Eye Cream every night for two weeks twice daily; I'm genuinely impressed with the results. The cream is lightweight, non-greasy, and absorbs quickly into the skin. This made it easy to incorporate into both my morning and evening skincare routines. What truly surprised me is how fast the results became visible. Within just two days, I noticed a reduction in fine lines and under-eye puffiness. My eye area feels smoother, looks more refreshed, and more lifted and sculpted overall. Although I loved the results, over time there were noticeable reactions that are indicative of an allergy. If this had not been an obstacle, I would have loved to include this product into my daily regimen. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I really loved the advanced night repair eye lift and sculpt eye cream. My undereye area tends to be dry,and when I apply concealer, it looks cakey as well as bringing out my fine lines. This eye cream helps to keep my undereyes looking plump and hydrated. I love the applicator and how comfortable it feels. I have added this product to my daily night routine. I recieved this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I really like Advanced Night Repair Eye Lift + Sculpt Eye Cream because my eye area is instantly hydrated and look refreshed in the morning. My dark circles appears diminished and the eye area skin is firmer and brighter. It is an amazing cream for my 52 year old eyes. They appear refreshed and more youthful after using for a week.
